decision_conditions:
ACCESSIBLE HOMES STANDARDS - (COMPLIANCE):  The residential dwellings, in accordance with the Access Statement and plans hereby approved, shall be constructed to the standards for flexible homes in Islington ('Accessible Housing in Islington' SPD) and incorporating all Lifetime Homes Standards.  

REASON:  To secure the provision of flexible, visitable and adaptable homes appropriate to diverse and changing needs.
description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) of permission reference: P2025/0504/FUL, dated: 02/06/2025 for 'Erection of a single storey side-fill extension, Installation of two rooflights to rear roof-slope, lowering internal floor level and associated internal alterations', amendments are for design refinements including incease in the height of the approved extension, the substitution of zinc cladding with timber cladding, and the alteration of an existing approved window to a door within the outrigger.
